howto.name: Paste JSON
howto.text: Enter a JSON object or array of objects. Nested objects are flattened to dot-notation columns.

howto.name: Inspect the inferred schema
howto.text: Each column shows its inferred type and how many rows contain a value.

howto.name: Copy or download CSV
howto.text: Export the flattened CSV for spreadsheets, BI tools, QA fixtures, or one-off data migrations.

faq.a: Nested keys are flattened with dot notation, such as user.email or billing.address.city.
The tool infers simple column types: empty, boolean, number, date, or string, plus value coverage per column.
No. Parsing, schema inference, and CSV generation all run in your browser.
